mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtering with recovery was most worthwhile: it showed that useful substances pass through the filter and must be taken back into the blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the bladder was straightforward and less interesting on its own, though it made the collection route clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose and water through along with wastes, rather than picking out just waste.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The final pairing was the only offered action and made sense as a way to follow the remaining fluid into the bladder.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: seeing how filtering and recovery work together was interesting, even if the final fittings were predictable.
